reviewMethod: Saved names/specifications compared with frozen sheet before holdout predictions were inspected. Reviewed by Codex; no human or manufacturer verification. Conflicting or insufficient evidence stays unresolved.
holdoutStatus: Fresh family-disjoint holdout selected after matcher implementation; excludes development sample and curated regression families. Conditional saved-frame remainder, not a live-catalog accuracy estimate. First evaluation revealed a demonstrable Vida Lite label error; corrected against proper row 1063. No matcher or rule changes followed holdout inspection. Gamdias extra B suffix remains a documented conservative miss.
